claim_text: Oil prices rose and were set for weekly gains after the United States threatened an indefinite blockade against Iran, with coverage on 16 August 2026 questioning how long such a blockade could be sustained.
quote: Oil rises after US threatens indefinite blockade of Iran; set for weekly gains
